releases.notes:
# 📚 Librarian Insight v1.1 — Minecraft 26.3

**Librarian Insight 1.1 is a major overhaul of the mod's interface and overall experience.**

The old menu has been replaced with a completely redesigned, Minecraft-native interface built to make librarian trade information faster to browse, easier to understand, and much nicer to use.

## ✨ Completely Redesigned Interface

- **Entirely new Librarian Insight menu**
- New Minecraft-inspired **dark oak, parchment, lapis, and gold** visual style
- Redesigned **Current Librarian**, **Possible Trades**, and **Villager Status** sections
- Smooth **animations and transitions**
- Improved hover and selection feedback
- Better item rendering and tooltips
- Responsive layouts for different **GUI scales and resolutions**
- Improved compact layout for smaller windows
- Redesigned merchant cost overlay

## 📖 New Enchanted Book Browser

Browsing librarian enchantments has received a major upgrade.

- New **expanded enchantment catalog**
- **Two-column layout** when enough screen space is available
- New **enchantment search**
- View enchantment levels and trade information directly
- Significantly more enchantments visible at once
- Improved scrolling for large catalogs
- **Mouse-wheel scrolling**
- **Draggable scrollbar**
- Improved selected-enchantment detail view

## 🌙 Dark Theme by Default

The **Dark theme is now the default** for new Librarian Insight installations.

- Dark theme has been redesigned around the new interface
- Light theme remains fully supported
- Existing saved theme preferences are preserved

## 🧵 Quilt Support

Librarian Insight now officially supports **Quilt**!

### Supported Mod Loaders

- **Fabric**
- **Quilt**
- **NeoForge**
- **Forge**

All four loaders provide the same Librarian Insight feature set and redesigned interface.

## 🛠️ Under the Hood

- Added reusable responsive layout handling
- Added time-based animation handling
- Shared Fabric/Quilt initialization where possible
- Improved multi-loader build verification
- Improved input and scrollbar handling
- Various rendering, compatibility, and UI fixes

---

**Librarian Insight 1.1 is the biggest interface update to the mod so far. Enjoy the new look!**

releases.notes:
# 📚 Librarian Insight v1.1 — Minecraft 26.2

**The complete Librarian Insight 1.1 redesign has been brought to Minecraft 26.2!**

This release backports the redesigned Minecraft 26.3 experience while maintaining the same functionality, visual design, and supported mod loaders.

## ✨ Completely Redesigned Interface

- **Entirely new Librarian Insight menu**
- New Minecraft-inspired **dark oak, parchment, lapis, and gold** visual style
- Redesigned **Current Librarian**, **Possible Trades**, and **Villager Status** sections
- Smooth **animations and transitions**
- Improved hover and selection feedback
- Better item rendering and tooltips
- Responsive layouts across different **GUI scales and resolutions**
- Improved compact layouts
- Redesigned merchant cost overlay

## 📖 New Enchanted Book Browser

Finding the librarian trade you're looking for is now considerably easier.

- New **expanded enchantment catalog**
- **Two-column layout** when screen space permits
- New **enchantment search**
- Detailed enchantment and trade information
- More enchantments visible at once
- Improved large-catalog scrolling
- **Mouse-wheel scrolling**
- **Draggable scrollbar**
- Improved selected-enchantment detail view

## 🌙 Dark Theme by Default

The redesigned **Dark theme is now the default** for new installations.

- Light theme remains fully supported
- Existing saved theme preferences are preserved

## 🧵 Quilt Support

Minecraft 26.2 now also receives official **Quilt support**.

### Supported Mod Loaders

- **Fabric**
- **Quilt**
- **NeoForge**
- **Forge**

## 🔄 Full 26.3 Backport

The Librarian Insight 1.1 experience has been fully adapted for Minecraft 26.2.

- Complete **1.1 UI redesign** backported
- Same feature set as the Minecraft 26.3 release
- Minecraft 26.2-specific rendering adaptations
- Updated Forge integration for Minecraft 26.2
- **No intentional visual or feature reductions** compared with 26.3

## 🛠️ Under the Hood

- Adapted item rendering for Minecraft 26.2
- Adapted pose and rotation rendering for the 26.2 API
- Shared Fabric/Quilt initialization where possible
- Improved multi-loader build verification
- Improved input and scrollbar handling
- Various compatibility, rendering, and UI fixes

---

**Minecraft 26.2 players now get the full Librarian Insight 1.1 experience.**

releases.notes:
Fixes
- Fixed Current and Minimum prices sometimes using the wrong villager trade instead of the enchanted book trade.
- Removed unnecessary “Vanilla” wording from trade information.
Minecraft 1.21.1
- Restored the normal hand-swing animation when interacting with lecterns.
- Fixed lecterns forgetting their associated librarian and trades after leaving and returning to the chunk.
- Fixed claimed librarian trades not appearing immediately.
- Corrected the list of possible librarian enchantments to accurately match Minecraft 1.21.1.
  - Density and Breach are correctly supported.
  - Wind Burst is no longer incorrectly listed as a possible librarian trade.
  - Post-1.21.1 enchantments such as Lunge are no longer shown.
- Corrected 1.21.1 librarian trade data and pricing.
- Restored the correct Master-level Name Tag trade instead of newer-version candle trades.
- Fixed incorrect rendering of item icons on the lectern overlay.
Minecraft 26.3
- Fixed Current/Minimum pricing selecting the wrong trade when the enchanted book isn't the librarian's first offer.
- Removed unnecessary “Vanilla” wording from the interface.
Internal
- Improved version-specific trade handling to better match Minecraft's actual enchantment and villager trade data.
- Added regression coverage for enchanted-book trade selection and 1.21.1 librarian trades.

releases.notes:
### Librarian Insight 1.0.1.1 – Fabric for Minecraft 1.21.1

- Added support for Minecraft 1.21.1
- Backported Librarian Insight's existing features from Minecraft 26.3
- Updated rendering, UI, villager data, trade prediction, interactions, and other systems for Minecraft 1.21.1
- Preserved librarian trade predictions, lectern displays, merchant overlays, villager icons, configuration, and commands
- Supports the experimental villager trade rebalance
- Updated to Java 21 and the appropriate Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric APIs
- Lunge is not included in the trade catalog because the enchantment does not exist in Minecraft 1.21.1

This is the initial Minecraft 1.21.1 backport and is being released as a **Beta** while it receives additional real-world testing.

**Requires Minecraft 1.21.1, Fabric Loader, and Fabric API.**
